mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to a decrease in S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the FEDFUNDS rate increased by more than 0.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points in the last three months indicates a tightening labor market, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3pp in the last three months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening consumer demand, which is expected to drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS increased by more than 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals a weakening supply side, which historically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO decreased by more than 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods where CPIAUCSL remained below 2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in the last month, combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points, signals a strong labor market, which is expected to drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200k and UNRATE decrease > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month indicates a broad-based increase in demand, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% quarter-over-quarter, combined with an increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% month-over-month, signals a supply-side recovery in the face of weak demand, which historically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 decrease > 0.5% QoQ and INDPRO increase > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where both conditions are met.
